headline: Nous Research, maker of the open-source Hermes Agent, has raised $90 million and is moving into business AI.
score_reason: Pool 5, kept: funding confirmed by the company on 7 Oct.
importance_line: It matters because a popular open-source AI agent is becoming a paid business, but the valuation is the company's own confirmation and the usage figures are its estimates.
summary: TechCrunch reports that Nous Research has confirmed a $90 million second major funding round at a $1.5 billion valuation, led by Robot Ventures, and will use the money for Hermes for Businesses, custom AI agents that handle multi-step work with private data. The Wall Street Journal reports the company had a yearly revenue pace of about $36 million by mid-September 2026 and expects to pass $100 million by the end of 2026.
notes: Full article read. The round's earlier TechCrunch report is not dated in our sources.
